Synopsis:

Major central banks (Fed, BOJ, ECB, BOE) navigating rate decisions. Asian equity markets mixed; yen strengthening on BOJ hawkish signals; ECB near-certain quarter-point hike Thursday. Gold and Bitcoin rising. Risk sentiment broadly cautious.

Q01. Is the content's main message about EU energy, EU commodities, German power market prices, German energy economics?

Q02. Is the content confirming already known information or reporting very new/uncertain risks?
Risk score: 55 — The Middle East escalation involving direct US-Iran military exchanges and Houthi strikes on Saudi cities represents a meaningful escalation beyond previously known tensions, introducing genuine supply-side uncertainty. However, oil price pressure and central bank tightening expectations were already partially priced in.
